title: 第一卷 第15章 谁给妖兽喂的合欢丹第一卷 第16章 我想了想还是得回来打死你
content_zh:
砰的一声！
刚想到这里，数丈之外的顾尘脚下猛地用力，身形瞬间纵起，立身之处的山石顿时四分五裂！
第一次！
在搏杀许久之后，他第一次有了反击之力，亦是第一次主动出手！
身形掠过，疾风骤起！
体内的灵溪诀一改先前绵绵悠悠之势，忽而变得迅猛湍急起来！
抛开伤势。
相比锻体中期，他的气力又是增长了不少，速度亦是提升了许多，须臾间已是跨越了数丈的距离，也没有任何招式神通，还是简简单单一拳砸落而下！
也不知为何，面对此刻的顾尘，孟海竟是有种面对一头绝世凶兽的感觉！
而且！
是一头受了伤的凶兽！
砰的一声！
他下意识防守，却只觉得这一拳重若千钧，砸得他气血奔涌，身体发麻，竟隐隐体会到了顾尘先前的感觉！
好重的拳！
孟海头皮有点麻！
别说后期了，便是寻常锻体巅峰，又有功法的加成，气力也不及此刻的顾尘！
怎么可能……
“砰——！”
念头转了一半，顾尘又是一拳落下！
这一拳！

比前一拳还要重了几分！
“你……”
“砰——！！”
再一拳落下，竟又是重了不少！
和吴飞一样，自遇到顾尘以来，孟海第一次心中多出了一丝名为恐惧的情绪！
他发现他对顾尘一无所知！而基于自己所谓的常识对顾尘的一通分析，更是错得离谱！
“你，到底是谁！”
全力接下顾尘一拳，他红着眼睛问了一句。
只是——
“砰——！！！”
回答他的，又是一记又重又快又狠的拳头！
“砰砰砰砰——！”
灵溪拳势一起，便再也停不下来了！
一拳快似一拳！
一拳强过一拳！
面对顾尘的拳势，孟海好似听到了战场中隐隐响起了一道道溪流潺潺的声音，声音越来越急，越来越快，不过须臾间，便已是化作了湍湍激流，直至最后，竟有了一丝澎湃之意！
“轰——！”
又是一拳落下，竟是有几分激流拍岸的气象，竟是震得孟海踉跄后退！
每退一步，他面色便要苍白一分，直至最后，他退至数丈之外，一个没忍住，大口吐血！
content_en:
Bang!
Just when he thought of this, Gu Chen, who was a few feet away, exerted force on his feet, and his body instantly rose up, and the rocks where he stood immediately fell into pieces!
first!
After fighting for a long time, he had the power to fight back for the first time, and it was also the first time he took the initiative!
The figure passed by and the wind suddenly rose!
The Lingxi Jue in the body changed from its slow and slow flow to suddenly becoming fast and furious!
Put aside the injury.
Compared with the middle stage of training, his strength has increased a lot, and his speed has also increased a lot. In an instant, he has crossed a distance of several feet. He does not have any magical powers, and he can still just punch down with a single punch!
For some reason, facing Gu Chen at this moment, Meng Hai felt as if he was facing a peerless beast!
and!
It's a wounded beast!
Bang!
He subconsciously defended himself, but he only felt that the punch was as heavy as a thousand stones. It made his blood surge and his body numb. He could faintly feel what Gu Chen felt before!
What a hard punch!
Meng Hai's scalp is a little numb!
Not to mention the later stage, even at the peak of ordinary physical training, with the bonus of martial arts, his strength is not as strong as Gu Chen at the moment!
How is it possible...
"Bang——!"
Halfway through his thoughts, Gu Chen punched him again!
This punch!
It was a bit harder than the previous punch!
"You..."
"Bang——!!"
The next punch landed, and it was a lot harder!
Like Wu Fei, for the first time since meeting Gu Chen, Meng Hai felt a trace of fear in his heart!
He discovered that he knew nothing about Gu Chen! And his analysis of Gu Chen based on his so-called common sense was even more wrong!
"Who are you!"
Taking Gu Chen's punch with all his strength, he asked with red eyes.
Just——
"Bang——!!!"
His answer was another heavy, fast and fierce fist!
“Bang bang bang bang—!”
Lingxi's fist moves together and he can't stop anymore!
A punch is as fast as a punch!
One punch is stronger than the other!
Facing Gu Chen's fist, Meng Hai seemed to hear the faint sounds of gurgling streams in the battlefield. The sounds became faster and faster, but in a moment, they turned into turbulent torrents, until finally, there was a hint of surging!
"Boom——!"
Another punch landed, and it was almost like a torrent crashing on the shore. It was so shocking that Meng Hai staggered back!
With every step he took, his face became paler, until finally, he retreated several feet away, unable to hold back, vomiting blood!
